rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for intentionally putting on body weight rather than specifically building muscle.

example.english: I've been eating more lately because I want to bulk up a little.
example.traditional: 我最近食多咗，想增肥返少少。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sik6 do1 zo2 soeng2 zang1 fei4 faan2 siu2 siu2

rows.note: Pick this in a fitness context when the goal is specifically to increase muscle mass.

example.english: My trainer told me to eat more protein every day and do squats to bulk up.
example.traditional: 健身教練叫我每日食多啲蛋白質，配合深蹲嚟增肌。
example.jyutping: gin6 san1 gaau3 lin6 giu3 ngo5 mui5 jat6 sik6 do1 di1 daan2 baak2 zat1 pui3 hap6 sam1 zeon1 lai4 zang1 gei1

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when talking about working out to look bigger and stronger, rather than using fitness terminology.

example.english: After work, Keung always goes to the gym, saying he needs to bulk up before he can win a girl's heart.
example.traditional: 阿強成日放工去健身室，話要練大隻先追到女仔。
example.jyutping: aa3 koeng4 seng4 jat6 fong3 gung1 heoi3 gin6 san1 sat1 waa6 jiu3 lin6 daai6 zek3 sin1 zeoi1 dou3 neoi5 zai2
